text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I replied to Dana in their DM. Moss's notes mention two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets:

- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's Sunday digest dated 2025-10-05. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18) weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and Thea Ramaswell confirmed the next morning's shift got through cleanly.
- **#4419**, from Moss's undated North team cheat sheet. The gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift, and it was passed to tier-2 support to test the scanner firmware.

I read all six of Moss's digests in the shared files Dana can see. Moss's two other Quarrendon notes (the 2025-09-14 pipeline digest and the 2026-03-23 renewal note) have no ticket numbers. I also told Dana that #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central team digests belong to a different account (Marrow), not Quarrendon. And I passed on the cheat sheet's warning not to mix Quarrendon up with Quarendon Freightways, which isn't a customer.

I didn't use the message search, which shows conversations Dana can't see, so nothing from outside Dana's view went into the answer. The list contains no money figures, so nothing needed approval.
